question: Does text add prioritization value beyond dated EPSS and structured information?
interpretation: Retrospective VulnCheck catalogue membership at a verified backup, not absence of exploitation or future exploitation prediction.

label_definition.1: LISTED in complete verified official backup
label_definition.0: NOT_LISTED in that same backup, not confirmed unexploited
label_definition.null: UNKNOWN until complete backup verification succeeds

comparison_design.threshold_policy: Select alert cutoff on inner selection data only; freeze before assessment. No test or assessment threshold optimization.

comparison_design.epss_policy: A separate date-verified EPSS snapshot at the catalogue backup UTC date; no silent reuse of publication-Day-60 scores as current EPSS.
comparison_design.predictor_policy: Allowlisted CVSS and deduplicated reference counts; all catalogue/CISA fields excluded. Text answer-disclosure review required before reusing graphs.
comparison_design.split_policy: Training-role candidates only at this stage. Later evidence-group-disjoint fitting/selection/assessment protocol must be frozen; old test sets are not new independent tests.
